description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific image upgrade and configuration management for embedded Linux devices, including partition handling, copying configurations, and flashing images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image for partition layout changes and readiness for upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the new partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process, including partition comparison, image writing, and bootloader update.
